Name: Lategame Fish Rebalance
Author: Imbion
Description:
People might disagree with me, but I think fishing is a decent profit method. However, later into the game, it falls off hard. The profits you can make from targeting even the rarer fishes pale in comparison to your starfruit wine farm. This mod intends to rectify this problem, ensuring that fishing is profitable even late into the game without making the early game fish too powerful.

[u][b]Requirements:
[/b][/u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/240]SMAPI[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher [/url]

[u][b]What it does:
[/b][/u]This mod changes the price of regular and legendary fish. It should be compatible with everything, as long as it doesn't modify the fish prices.

High difficulty, seasonal, and conditional fish are worth more, while common fish are approximately the same price. Some of the uncommon fish have been slightly buffed, while the rarest fish in the game sell for significantly more.  You'll find with this mod that targeting specific fish will be more profitable, rather than just fishing at the nearest body of water.

Some sample changes:
- Salmon is worth more than Largemouth Bass, as Salmon can only be found in the fall.
- Midnight Carp can only be caught in a four hour window. Since you have to specifically hunt for it, the sell amount is increased.
- The Octopus is generally considered the rarest and hardest to catch fish in the game. It has been buffed accordingly.

All of the price changes are documented [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/16wLlnNrEiOxc6oTY_J_PDn6xlKs3jALCg5Kqgyy6uQg/edit?usp=sharing]here[/url].

[u][b]Mods Changed by LFR:
[/b][/u]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url] 

[b][u]Config Options:[/u][/b]
- Choose a balance mode
﻿- Main: Default option, aka the mod's base intended design
﻿- Decreased: Reduces the prices of fish from the main version, but still keeps the general design considerations
﻿- Rarity: Price of common/uncommon fish matches decreased, rarer fish are worth way more than the main version
﻿- Disabled: Turn off the mod's changes to regular fish
- Enable/disable Sashimi price change (75 -> 100)
- Enable/disable Jelly price change
- Toggle Legendary & Legendary II changes

If you have any feedback, feel free to let me know your thoughts.
